issues.quote: revenue rising 51.4% to $53.8 billion from $53.8 billion in fiscal 2021
issues.problem: Tesla's FY2022 revenue was about $81.5 billion, not $53.8 billion. $53.8 billion is the FY2021 figure. The sentence also contradicts itself: going from $53.8B to $53.8B can't be 51.4% growth. The 51.4% growth rate is correct for $53.8B to $81.5B.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, but it gives the wrong FY2022 revenue: $53.8B instead of about $81.5B. Gross profit, the margins (which match $81.5B revenue), operating income, net income, EPS and R&D figures all match what I know of Tesla's reported results.
